note: Requested partner fonts deliberately NOT in manifest.json, and license discrepancies between the Open Siddur fonts page and each font's own distribution. Rendered into LINKS.md by scripts/add_os_font.py — the record of what was refused and why.

categories.title: License not on the partner allowlist
categories.note: Most of these are Culmus fonts. Culmus ships ONE combined LICENSE covering 13 families, and the font exception in that file sits in Yoram Gnat's sections only — it does not reach Maxim Iorsh's families or the Fancy Fonts. Matching each font to its own section is what separates them; a whole-file search wrongly clears all 13. The fonts page agrees on every font listed here.

categories.title: Declared allowlisted upstream, but no license text ships
categories.note: The fonts page declares these allowlisted, but their distributions carry no license text, so no byte-faithful LICENSE.txt can be staged. Maintainer decision 2026-08-26: leave them out rather than compose one.

categories.title: Not obtainable
categories.note: The fonts page links these downloads, but the folders are absent from aharonium/opensiddur.org and opensiddur.org itself was unreachable.
